schedule_time_convention: Raw JSON decimal endpoints must exactly tile [0,duration_s] before checked binary64 projection. Represented endpoints define library support; logical substep times use their exact rational differences and explicit per-segment counts. Saved time_s is a rounded stamp, while segment and step retain exact logical association.
